task.description: Read step-01-issue-fixer.json's diagnosis in full: web/tsconfig.json is a TypeScript solution-style root config ('files': [] plus references-only), meaningful only under 'tsc -b' (build mode). web/package.json's type-check script runs plain 'tsc --noEmit', which resolves to zero files and always exits 0. Produce a design for the fix specifying: (1) the exact new type-check script command (build-mode tsc -b, matching the existing build script's 'tsc -b && vite build' pattern); (2) whether incremental .tsbuildinfo caching needs handling for fail-fast CI reliability (flagged as open question) -- decide and justify; (3) confirm no regression to tsconfig.app.json/tsconfig.node.json's project-reference structure or the build/dev scripts; (4) acceptance-criteria mapping back to ISS-0274.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Exact new type-check script command stated, matching the build script's tsc -b pattern
Explicit decision (with reasoning) on whether --force/clean-step/as-is is correct for .tsbuildinfo incremental caching under CI fail-fast reliability, not deferred as still-open
Confirmation that tsconfig.app.json/tsconfig.node.json's project-reference structure and the build/dev scripts are unaffected
Mapping from ISS-0274.yaml's acceptance criteria to concrete design elements
No .ts/.ex/.json implementation code beyond the single literal script-value change -- design doc only

result.summary:

No implementation code in the doc -- one literal script-value line change, quoted JSON snippets of existing (unmodified) files for context only, and prose/reasoning throughout.
